snippet.title: Paris Jackson Opens Up About Her Deep Personal Bond With Father Michael Jackson ❤️ | Emotional Clip
snippet.description:
Paris Jackson appeared on the "Trying Not to Die" podcast hosted by Jack Osbourne. In this May 2026 interview, she had a raw and honest conversation about grief, healing, and growing up in the spotlight.

In this heartfelt clip, Paris explains why she no longer feels pressured to post publicly about her father Michael Jackson on his birthday, death anniversary, or Father’s Day. She shares that people expect her to express love like a fan, but for her it was a real personal relationship — not a parasocial one.

She emotionally reveals that Michael Jackson was her best friend, and she now chooses to hold that beautiful bond close to her heart. It’s no one’s business, and there’s freedom in not performing her grief for the world.

A touching and respectful moment about family, boundaries, and authentic love

snippet.title: Ellie the Elephant's Epic MJ Tribute at Barclays Center 🐘🎤
snippet.description:
Ellie the Elephant delivered an UNFORGETTABLE Michael Jackson tribute during halftime at the New York Liberty WNBA game! 🐘👑

On May 21, 2026, at Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York, Liberty’s beloved mascot Ellie brought the heat with smooth moves, moonwalk, and classic MJ vibes including Billie Jean energy. Even in a tough loss to the Golden State Valkyries (70-87), Ellie stole the show!

🎤 Songs Featured: Billie Jean, The Way You Make Me Feel & more!

**About Ellie the Elephant:**
Ellie the Elephant (aka Big Ellie) is the official mascot of the New York Liberty. Introduced in 2021, she represents strength, power, and New York pride — named after Ellis Island with a crown inspired by the Statue of Liberty. Known for her incredible dance performances and tributes to legends like Beyoncé, Whitney Houston, Mary J. Blige, Nicki Minaj, and now Michael Jackson, Ellie has become one of the most entertaining mascots in all of sports!

Who else thinks Ellie is the best mascot in the WNBA? 🔥

snippet.title: Michael Jackson Voice Recording – Space Channel 5: Part 2 (2002)
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson recorded his voice as “Space Michael” for Sega’s rhythm game Space Channel 5: Part 2, released in 2002.

In this raw studio recording, you can hear Michael Jackson delivering his lines with his signature energy and charisma. He had previously made a cameo in Space Channel 5 (1999/2000) after seeing a preview of the game and expressing interest. For the sequel, he was given a much larger role and recorded multiple dialogue lines.

This collaboration highlights Michael Jackson’s interest in video games and his willingness to explore different creative projects beyond music.

Game: Space Channel 5: Part 2  
Developer: Sega  
Year: 2002

snippet.title: Michael Jackson Biopic Takes Over South Korea! Powerful New Promotion Released
snippet.description:
Michael is dominating the South Korean box office.

Universal Pictures Korea shared these powerful visuals to celebrate the film’s strong run with local fans.

The Michael Jackson biopic, starring Jaafar Jackson in the title role, was released in South Korea on May 13, 2026 with a mid-week launch. It opened strongly, selling 99,903 tickets on its first day. Over the weekend of May 15–17, the film continued its momentum with 470,375 admissions, earning $3.6 million and claiming the #1 spot at the box office with a commanding 51% market share. As of now, it has already crossed $4.8 million in total gross from more than 647,900 admissions in just one week.

Jaafar Jackson’s performance as Michael Jackson is clearly connecting with Korean audiences, proving once again the global power of the King of Pop’s story.

Big respect to the Korean fans for showing this kind of love. Fans worldwide are now buzzing with excitement about the biopic.

#MichaelMovie #JaafarJackson #MichaelJackson #MJBiopic #BoxOffice #SouthKorea
Credit: @universalpictureskr

snippet.title: World’s Biggest Vertical Record Player Built in NYC for Michael Biopic | Behind the Scenes
snippet.description:
World’s Largest Spinning Golden Record Billboard in NYC! 👑

Behind the scenes of an epic movie promotion for Michael Jackson! This massive kinetic installation is the world’s largest vertical record player — a giant spinning golden vinyl record that actually rotates, plays music, and glows with a neon “Michael” sign at night.

Built in April 2026 near Javits Center, New York City, it was created as a spectacular promotional stunt for the Michael Jackson biopic “Michael” (released April 24, 2026). Designed by Experiential Supply Co. and fabricated by The Factory NYC, this unforgettable billboard perfectly celebrated the King of Pop’s legacy.

A true next-level tribute to the King of Pop! 👑

#MichaelMovie #MichaelJackson #MJBiopic #KingOfPop #NYCBillboard
@the_factory_nyc

snippet.title: Akon & Les Twins Epic Michael Jackson Dangerous Tribute in Paris 2026 🔥
snippet.description:
EPIC MICHAEL JACKSON TRIBUTE IN PARIS! 🔥

On 12th May 2026, Akon delivered a powerful tribute to Michael Jackson at the Accor Arena in Paris, France.

During the “Nights Like This Tour” with Ne-Yo, Akon performed Michael Jackson’s iconic song “Dangerous” with massive fire effects, smoke, red lighting, and full energy. He was joined on stage by the legendary dance duo Les Twins (Larry & Laurent Bourgeois), who killed the choreography in true MJ style.

The stage turned into a complete King of Pop moment — white outfits, intense visuals, and the crowd going wild!

Event Details:

• Date: Tuesday, 12 May 2026
• Venue: Accor Arena, Paris, France
• Artists: Akon ft. Les Twins
• Song: “Dangerous” (Michael Jackson Tribute)

Even after so many years, Michael Jackson’s legacy continues to inspire big artists on stage. 👑

snippet.title: May 10, 2009: Michael Jackson’s Emotional Recording About Children 💔
snippet.description:
💔 Even heavily sedated… his heart was still only thinking about children.

This is a rare recording from May 10, 2009 (just 6 weeks before he left us), where Michael Jackson talks about building a children’s hospital with the money from his comeback tour.

“I love them… because I didn’t have a childhood… I feel their pain… I hurt… it hurt.”

No matter what the world said about him, his soul was always pure when it came to kids. This is the real Michael Jackson. ❤️

#MichaelJackson #MJ #PureSoul #KingOfPop #Neverland
Credit: CBS News (court footage from Conrad Murray trial, 2011)
